concerns.text: T009 re-runs the thin pipeline, but both T003 (thin) and T004 (full) write the SAME artifact `data/results/per_sample_errors.csv`. Executing T009 after T004 clobbers the full-run per-sample results that T010/T011/T012 aggregate and reference, corrupting the final deliverables. Thin and full runs must write to distinct paths, or T009 must restore/verify the full-run file.

T009 asserts 'all metric values in data/results/metrics_raw.csv match a stored reference' after re-running the thin pipeline, but the thin pipeline (T003) does not produce metrics_raw.csv — that file is first produced by T005 from the FULL run. T009's verification chain has a missing producer step: it must either re-run thin + T005's metrics computation into a separate thin-scoped output, or compare against a full-run reference with the full pipeline re-executed.

T008 says 'Wrap the full pipeline with a psutil resource monitor' and writes performance_log.json, but T004 already ran the full pipeline in a prior task. As ordered, T008's monitor can only observe a re-run; state explicitly that T008's instrumentation is integrated into `code/pipeline.py`/`code/main.py` and exercised via a re-execution (or fold the monitoring into T004) so the measured run is unambiguous.
